tagline.en_US: Serve offline websites and reference libraries from ZIM files on your network. This single-container service needs an existing host directory containing at least one .zim file; it does not require a separate application.

description.en_US: Kiwix Serve is an HTTP daemon designed to serve content stored in ZIM files. It allows users to access and navigate offline websites and reference libraries across a local network without requiring internet connectivity. It is useful for distributing documentation, encyclopedias, and other educational materials offline.
